messages:
elaine-security: Auditor asked for a clear mapping of incident evidence -> SOC2 control IDs, plus where vuln triage artifacts live. I started a draft but need confirmations on retention, encryption, and proof-of-delivery.

sam-sre: Is this about production incidents or also staging?

elaine-security: Primary ask is prod, but auditor wants sampling showing staging separation too. They want: log export path, retention window, KMS key used, signature/hash proof, and who approved exports.

maria-eng: For prod exports we push daily snapshots to s3://redwood-evidence/prod-incident-exports/YYYY-MM-DD/, encrypted with alias/redwood-evidence-prod (CMK). Rotation is annual; we can show the rotation schedule from KMS.

sam-sre: Confirm retention: logs in hot-tier 90d, cold-tier (S3 Glacier) 3 years for evidence artifacts. SIEM raw events retained 1 year. We have a lifecycle rule that transitions artifacts after 30 days to Glacier.

auditor-kevin: Can you show a sample manifest that proves which files were exported for a given incident and a sha256 for each file? Also need the identity that triggered the export (service account or person).

elaine-security: Yes. Example manifest we plan to provide:

```
{
  "incident_id": "INC-2026-0453",
  "exported_by": "svc-evidence-exporter@redwood",
  "export_time": "2026-01-14T02:04:12Z",
  "files": [
    {"path": "s3://redwood-evidence/prod-incident-exports/2026-01-14/syslogs.tar.gz", "sha256": "b3f8..."},
    {"path": "s3://redwood-evidence/prod-incident-exports/2026-01-14/kv-cache-dump.json", "sha256": "7a9d..."}
  ],
  "kms_key_alias": "alias/redwood-evidence-prod",
  "signature": "sig-v1:MEUCIQ..."
}
```

maria-eng: The exporter signs the manifest with an internal key (HSM-backed) and we store the signature alongside the manifest. We can export the signing certificate chain for auditor validation.

sam-sre: On identity: exports are executed by a service account svc-evidence-exporter that requires an on-call approval workflow for manual exports. Automated daily exports use a different role with restricted scope and are auditable via cloudtrail. We can map the two flows.

auditor-kevin: I need one example manual export with the approval ticket and the cloudtrail entry showing the assume-role call. Can you attach a redacted ticket and the trail snippet?

elaine-security: Yep — will assemble a bundle. QUESTION for @maria-eng: for Private deployments (VPC), does the same exporter push to customer-owned buckets? How do we prove encryption when key is customer-managed?

maria-eng: For Private we support two modes: 1) we write to a pre-authorized presigned upload URL into customer bucket (customer CMK), or 2) we send an encrypted bundle back to the customer's SFTP endpoint. In either case the manifest includes the KMS key id or wrapped-key blob. We can show the envelope key headers and the wrapping CMK id for proof.

opsbot: export-job 0x7f4c started by svc-evidence-exporter at 2026-01-14T02:04:12Z (prod). job-id=0x7f4c status=running

sam-sre: For SOC2 mapping: S3 retention + lifecycle -> CC6.5 (evidence retention); KMS + envelope -> CC6.1 (cryptographic controls); export approvals -> CC6.2 (change/approval). Let's add those to the control mapping doc.

elaine-security: Good. Also need to include vuln triage artifacts: jira ticket links, patched commit hashes, container image digests, and the timeline. These are requested by the ISO 27001 auditor too.

maria-eng: We keep vuln triage output files in s3://redwood-vuln-triage/YYYY/ with a manifest referencing git commit SHA and image digest. Sample triage entry:

```
- ticket: RDW-4521
  status: remediated
  commit: 9f2c4d7
  image_digest: sha256:4a5b...
  triage_notes_blob: s3://redwood-vuln-triage/2026/9f2c4d7/notes.txt
```

auditor-kevin: For the triage artifacts, auditor wants evidence that the CI pipeline tags the artifact immutably and that the commit author and PR approval chain are recorded. Can you include a CI run link and signed provenance?

sam-sre: We can pull a run from buildkite with the pipeline id and include the GPG-signed commit if available. For images we publish SBOM and sigs to our internal registry.

elaine-security: Action items: 1) Maria to produce a redacted example manifest + signature + KMS rotation log. 2) Sam to pull cloudtrail snippet and lifecycle policy JSON. 3) Provide one manual export proof with approval ticket (redacted). 4) Provide vuln triage bundle: ticket, commit, image digest, CI link, SBOM.

maria-eng: I'll drop the artifacts into a temp evidence bucket and share a presigned URL with auditor-kevin. ETA EOD PST.

auditor-kevin: Thanks — presigned link is fine. Please include a short README that maps each file -> control IDs and the exact query used to extract the logs. Auditor will validate hashes.

elaine-security: noted. Also leaving a note: for future we should add an automated 'evidence export' endpoint in the console that creates a signed bundle and a single-use download token. Filing a ticket for that: PLAT-1209.

sam-sre: +1. That will make audits way easier.

opsbot: export-job 0x7f4c status=completed exit=0 duration=00:00:18 artifacts=3 manifest=s3://redwood-evidence/prod-incident-exports/2026-01-14/manifest.json

maria-eng: Uploaded sample bundle, presigned URL sent to @auditor-kevin (redacted) — manifest, signature, KMS rotation log, and a redacted approval ticket included.

auditor-kevin: Got it. Reviewing now, will ping if anything missing. Thanks all :thumbsup:

elaine-security: Great — I'll update the control mapping doc and post the final checklist to the auditor channel when we close this.
